pack.name: image-codec-fixtures
pack.summary: JPEG, GIF, WebP, AVIF, BMP, TIFF, ICO, TGA, QOI, HDR, EXR and farbfeld — inputs paired with decoded reference renderings, plus corpora that must fail to decode.

license.covers: image-rs/image is offered under MIT or Apache-2.0 at the reader's choice; the MIT grant is the one relied on here and the one snapshotted. The declaration is repository-wide — these are the crate's regression images, not separately declared assets — and the two sub-corpora that DO carry their own declarations are split into the blocks below rather than swept under this one.

Quoting the suite's own LICENSE: the format specification, sample images and utilities 'originally been publicly available, free of charge and under no specific licensing terms, from TrueVision, Inc.'s FTP server', and 'all of the material contained here is therefore copyright to TrueVision, Inc., unless otherwise stated.' No terms specified is not a grant, so nothing is claimed here.
The 3-Clause BSD License, Copyright (c) web-platform-tests contributors. Carried into image-rs with the LICENSE.md and README.txt that came with it, both of which are included here.
zlib licence, Copyright (C) 1997-2025 Sam Lantinga. Permits use for any purpose including commercial, with no attribution requirement beyond not misrepresenting the origin of altered source.

webmproject/libwebp-test-data carries no licence file. The sibling libwebp repository is BSD-3-Clause, but that declaration is about the library and was not carried into this repository; nothing here establishes terms for the data.
CC0 1.0 Universal — dedicated to the public domain by Clinton Ingram, with no attribution requirement.
